title: Layer 0.1 — Life Timeline
goal: Create a concise but evidence-rich life timeline with formative periods, turning points, identity shifts and recurring themes.

title: Layer 0.2 — Major Decisions
goal: Map 20–50 important decisions with context, reasoning, fears, outcomes and retrospective lessons.

title: Layer 0.3 — Success & Failure Patterns
goal: Extract repeated success and failure patterns, including conditions under which they appear.

title: Layer 1.1 — Identity Architecture
goal: Infer stable identity structures from evidence while distinguishing traits, skills, adaptations and narratives.

title: Layer 1.2 — Values & Utility Function
goal: Model what Pierre optimizes for, what he minimizes, trade-offs, constraints and state-dependent value shifts.

title: Layer 1.3 — Meaning Architecture
goal: Map what feels deeply meaningful, empty, fulfilling or existentially important.

title: Layer 1.4 — Moral & Integrity Logic
goal: Map how Pierre determines right/wrong, fairness, ethics, compromise limits and integrity boundaries.

title: Layer 1.5–1.6 — Non-Negotiables & Tension Map
goal: Identify must-have/must-not-have conditions and permanent tensions Pierre must navigate.

title: Layer 2.1 — Cognitive Architecture
goal: Map systems thinking, abstraction, pattern recognition, causal/probabilistic reasoning and complexity handling.

title: Layer 2.2 — Decision Architecture
goal: Model how Pierre makes decisions: intuition/analysis, risk, timing, reversibility, conviction and hesitation.

title: Layer 2.3 — Execution Architecture
goal: Map how Pierre produces results, including flow conditions, blockers, perfectionism and shipping patterns.

title: Layer 2.4 — State Dynamics
goal: Model Pierre's operating states and transitions, including triggers, strengths, weaknesses, risks and exit strategies.

title: Layer 2.5–2.8 — Energy, Learning, Failure Modes & Meta-Bias
goal: Map energy economics, learning architecture, anti-self/failure modes, recovery protocols and meta-biases.

title: Layer 4 — Reference Models Seed
goal: Create a seed document for MBTI, Big Five, DISC, vocational and complementary lenses with epistemic tiering.

title: Layer 5 — QI Human Architecture Seed
goal: Create initial WHER/QI mapping of Pierre using only available evidence and clearly marked unknowns.
